A '''male Dubravan''' worked as a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dubrava/Legends|Dubrava]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Dubravan]] sold a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Jal Te Gniev]], who was fleeing from the world to warn [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was on its way to get him on the planet [[Jazbina/Legends|Jazbina]].
